bee-cell.description: Bee Cell 1.0 — HEOSSI's free, entry-tier model and the one used in every SDK/curl example on https://bee.heossi.com/docs/sdks (retrieved 2026-09-28), so it is the most defensible default without a live probe. Free hosted access, no card required: 'Full Bee experience with dynamic fair use — free to start' (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-28). Context 128K and $0.30 / $1.20 per 1M input/output tokens per the same pricing page; no per-request output-token ceiling is documented. The 2026-07-11 changelog states tool/function calling and JSON-mode structured output are live on Comb, Buzz and Hive only — Cell is not named, so tools/structured output are not assumed here. No image input is documented for this tier. Roster-verified only (unauthenticated GET /bee/models, 2026-09-28); no live capability probe was run (credential-free onboarding).

bee-cell-20260710-r1.description: Immutable pinned snapshot behind the bee-cell alias (current_snapshot field on GET /bee/models, 2026-09-28). Same tier as bee-cell; see that entry for pricing/context. Roster-listed only.

bee-brood.description: Bee Brood 1.0 — second tier, $30/mo on the Workspace track or $0.60 / $2.40 per 1M input/output tokens on the API track (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-28). Context 256K per the same page. Not named among Comb/Buzz/Hive in the 2026-07-11 changelog's tool-calling/JSON-mode announcement, so those capabilities are not assumed for this tier. Fallback; roster-verified only, not capability-probed.

bee-brood-20260710-r1.description: Immutable pinned snapshot behind the bee-brood alias (GET /bee/models, 2026-09-28). Roster-listed only.

bee-comb.description: Bee Comb 2.0 (current snapshot bee-comb-20260827-r1 per GET /bee/models, 2026-09-28) — base context 256K, $1.25 / $5.00 per 1M input/output tokens (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-28). The 2026-07-11 changelog also describes a separately routed long-context mode serving up to 1,010,000 tokens for Comb and Buzz — that is a distinct routed path, not modeled as this catalog entry's context window. The same changelog entry states tool/function calling and JSON-mode structured output are live on Comb (along with Buzz and Hive) — see capabilities.tools ('model-dependent') and the provider-level structuredOutput note. Fallback; roster-verified only, not capability-probed.

bee-buzz.description: Bee Buzz 1.0 — HEOSSI's 'Popular' Workspace tier ($400/mo) / $2.50 / $10.00 per 1M input/output tokens on the API track (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-28). Context 256K, with the same 1,010,000-token routed long-context mode documented for Comb and Buzz (2026-07-11 changelog). Named alongside Comb and Hive in the 2026-07-11 changelog's tool-calling/JSON-mode-live announcement. Fallback; roster-verified only, not capability-probed.

bee-hive.description: Bee Hive 1.0 — $1,000/mo Workspace tier with a 99.5% SLA, or $5.00 / $20.00 per 1M input/output tokens on the API track (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-28). Base context 256K; the same pricing page says Hive reaches a 1M-token mode 'via Comb', a routing detail not modeled as this entry's context window. Named alongside Comb and Buzz in the 2026-07-11 changelog's tool-calling/JSON-mode-live announcement. Fallback; roster-verified only, not capability-probed.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://workspace.bee.heossi.com/account/api-keys and sign in (or create a Bee Workspace account)
2. Create an API key — the free Bee Cell / Bee Pollen tier needs no credit card ('Free hosted access — no card', https://bee.heossi.com/pricing)
3. Higher tiers (Brood/Comb/Buzz/Hive/Swarm) draw from a prepaid wallet billed per token; see https://bee.heossi.com/pricing for current rates
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.bee.heossi.com/bee — note the base path is /bee, not /v1. Six model tiers (Cell through Swarm); the free Cell/Pollen tier requires no card, paid tiers meter a prepaid wallet per token (https://bee.heossi.com/pricing).
